description: One wallet's Predict.fun positions and P&L, per outcome token: net shares, cost, proceeds, mark (last price), value (net x 1 won, x 0 lost, x mark while open), pnl = proceeds - cost + value, state (open, won, lost, uncatalogued); totals over ALL positions with realized (resolved) and unrealized (open) P&L. At most 500 positions are listed (open first, then the largest |pnl|): `positions_total` counts them all, `truncated` says some were left out. Exchange fills only: shares split, merged, redeemed or transferred are not seen.

address.description: The wallet, 0x and 40 hex digits. Required.

name: predictfun_wallet_positions
title: Predict.fun Wallet Positions
